none: PAS FindID 975469: Roman coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Northamptonshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine dating from AD 318 to AD 324 (Reece Period 16). Probably BEATA TRANQVILLITAS reverse type, depicting globe on altar inscribed VO/TIS/X X, although this depiction is hard to see in detail. Mint unclear. Diameter: 18.54mm, Thickness: 1.34mm, Weight: 1.8g
